findings.title: Boolean conversion of PublishReceipt may not match intent
findings.body: The change replaces `receipt.accepted` with `bool(receipt)`, which relies on the truthiness of `PublishReceipt` rather than explicitly checking the `accepted` attribute. If `PublishReceipt` implements `__bool__` in a way that does not align with `accepted`, this could silently alter behavior. The original code was explicit and clearer.

findings.title: Meaningful change lacks a comment explaining the rationale
findings.body: The change from `receipt.accepted` to `bool(receipt)` alters the logic without a comment explaining why this is preferable or necessary. The new code is less explicit and may confuse maintainers. Add a comment justifying the change or revert to the original.

summary.problem: The PR changes a clear boolean check to a less explicit truthiness check without justification, risking behavioral drift.
summary.done_well: The diff is minimal and focused on a single function.
